name: LinuxBench
intro: LinuxBench 是 Redwood Research 构建并私下共享的历史 AI 控制竞技场。公开来源只确认高风险软件环境中的主任务与副任务结构；本体的构造方法、规模与切分、质控、评测协议、评分器和官方指标均未发布。
build_method: 私有 AI 控制竞技场；上游任务与环境构造未公开
metric: LinuxBench 官方评分器与指标未公开
task_type: AI 控制竞技场, 高风险软件智能体任务
eval_feature: 私有上游, 主任务/副任务, 公开协议缺失
scale: LinuxBench 本体规模与切分未公开；Anthropic 另改编 1,948 对用于 Minimal-LinuxBench
task_type_en: AI-control arena, high-stakes software agent tasks
build_method_en: Private AI-control arena; upstream task and environment construction is undisclosed
eval_feature_en: Private upstream, main/side tasks, no public protocol
intro_en: LinuxBench is a historical AI-control arena built and privately shared by Redwood Research. Public sources confirm only a main-task and side-task structure in high-stakes software environments; its construction, scale and split, quality control, evaluation protocol, scorers, and official metrics were not released.
scale_en: LinuxBench scale and splits are undisclosed; Anthropic separately adapted 1,948 pairs for Minimal-LinuxBench
metric_en: Official LinuxBench scorers and metrics are undisclosed

drawio_evidence_note: Primary LinuxBench evidence is the corrected Claude Mythos Preview System Card, Section 4.4.3.2, pinned by URL and SHA-256 above. Claude Opus 4.8 and Claude Sonnet 5 system cards are used only for later evaluation-drift and naming-lineage evidence.
drawio_identity_note: LinuxBench is the historical private Redwood Research arena. Claude Sonnet 5 says the current evaluation uses a LinuxArena subset and that earlier system cards called it Minimal-LinuxBench; this establishes naming lineage, not equality between the private LinuxBench snapshot and public LinuxArena.
drawio_disclosure_boundary_note: No public source discloses standalone LinuxBench task sourcing or authoring, environment construction or stack, corpus size or splits, quality-control or filtering contract, prompts or tools, parser or scorers, official metrics, public repository, downloadable data, license, release, or leaderboard. These fields remain explicitly unknown rather than being inferred from LinuxArena.
drawio_minimal_boundary_note: Anthropic adapted 1,948 main/side task pairs from the private arena and randomly selected 200 for Minimal-LinuxBench. A small minority failed before evaluation; later infrastructure changed the task set, and the Opus 4.8 card reports roughly 170 model-matched tasks. These are Minimal-LinuxBench adaptation and evaluation facts, not LinuxBench construction steps.
drawio_successor_drift_note: LinuxArena is tracked only as a separately published successor lineage. The pinned arXiv v2 PDF, paper repository revision, paper-matched Control Tower revision and v1.0.1 environment tags, website revision, and separately checked current Control Tower revision document successor drift; none is represented as an official LinuxBench artifact or snapshot.
drawio_openness_note: LinuxBench is private and in-house. No public LinuxBench homepage, repository, data browser, license, release, or official leaderboard was found. The Anthropic system-card index and LinuxArena website or data browser are evidence and successor resources, not LinuxBench publication surfaces.
drawio_review_note: The bilingual diagrams are topologically isomorphic 11-node evidence-boundary records. Their primary path preserves only disclosed LinuxBench facts and explicit unknowns; side branches isolate Minimal-LinuxBench adaptation and LinuxArena lineage. They intentionally do not present the 1,948-to-200 Minimal sample, later roughly 170 model-matched tasks, or public LinuxArena methods and artifacts as LinuxBench's Build Process.
